newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP takes delivery of bulk carrier.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP takes delivery of bulk carrier.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Monday it had taken delivery of a 169,500 dwt bulk carrier from South Korea's Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd .
The ship, named Iron Yandi, is expected to arrive in Port Hedland, Western Australia on December 23 to load its first cargo of iron ore, the company said in a statement.
Iron Yandi would transport iron ore from Port Hedland to BHP's steel operations in Port Kembla and Newcastle, New South Wales and coal from Queenland ports to Japan, BHP said.
In the five months to October 31, BHP shipped a total of 19.63 million tonnes of coal and 21.76 million tonnes iron ore.
